Importance sampling for rare match outcomes

Source: R/simulation.R
importance_sample_rare.Rd

Estimates probabilities of rare events (e.g., 8+ goals, exact scoreline) with much lower variance than crude Monte Carlo.

Usage

importance_sample_rare(
  lambda_home,
  lambda_away,
  outcome,
  n_sims = 10000L,
  tilt = "auto"
)

Arguments

lambda_home

Numeric. Expected home goals.

lambda_away

Numeric. Expected away goals.

outcome

Character. Outcome to estimate:

  • "over_X" (e.g., "over_5.5", "over_7.5")

  • "exact_HH_AA" (e.g., "exact_5_3")

  • "home_X+" (e.g., "home_4+")

n_sims

Integer. Number of importance samples.

tilt

Numeric or "auto". Exponential tilting parameter. Higher values focus samples on rare events. "auto" estimates optimal tilt.

Value

A list with:

  • probability: Estimated probability

  • se: Standard error

  • effective_n: Effective sample size (lower if weights are uneven)

  • variance_reduction: Factor vs crude MC

See also

Other simulation: accumulator_probability(), joint_outcome_probability(), simulate_correlated_matches(), simulate_match_vr(), simulation
